name: Account Report 38
definition: Provides further details of the account report.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the account servicer, to unambiguously identify the account report.

ReportPagination.name: Report Pagination
ReportPagination.definition: Provides details on the page number of the report.||Usage: The pagination of the report is only allowed when agreed between the parties.

ElectronicSequenceNumber.name: Electronic Sequence Number
ElectronicSequenceNumber.definition: Sequential number of the report, as assigned by the account servicer. |Usage: The sequential number is increased incrementally for each report sent electronically.

ReportingSequence.name: Reporting Sequence
ReportingSequence.definition: Specifies the range of identification sequence numbers, as provided in the request.

LegalSequenceNumber.name: Legal Sequence Number
LegalSequenceNumber.definition: Legal sequential number of the report, as assigned by the account servicer. It is increased incrementally for each report sent.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the report was created.

FromToDate.name: From To Date
FromToDate.definition: Range of time between a start date and an end date for which the account report is issued.

CopyDuplicateIndicator.name: Copy Duplicate Indicator
CopyDuplicateIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the document is a copy, a duplicate, or a duplicate of a copy.

ReportingSource.name: Reporting Source
ReportingSource.definition: Specifies the application used to generate the reporting.

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account to which credit and debit entries are made.

RelatedAccount.name: Related Account
RelatedAccount.definition: Identifies the parent account of the account for which the report has been issued.

Interest.name: Interest
Interest.definition: Provides general interest information that applies to the account at a particular moment in time.

Balance.name: Balance
Balance.definition: Set of elements used to define the balance as a numerical representation of the net increases and decreases in an account at a specific point in time.

Entry.name: Entry
Entry.definition: Specifies an entry in the report.|Usage: At least one reference must be provided to identify the entry and its underlying transaction(s).||Usage Rule: In case of a Payments R-transaction the creditor / debtor referenced of the original payment initiation messages is also used for reporting of the R-transaction. The original debtor/creditor in the reporting of R-Transactions is not inverted. |Following elements all defined in the TransactionDetails in RelatedParties or RelatedAgents are impacted by this usage rule:|Creditor, UltimateCreditor, CreditorAccount, CreditorAgent, Debtor, UltimateDebtor, DebtorAccount and DebtorAgent.

AdditionalReportInformation.name: Additional Report Information
AdditionalReportInformation.definition: Further details of the account report.
